When subprograms are in use
column2: the main program is not jit'd after the

column1: subprograms because jit_subprogs sets a value for prog->bpf_func upon
success.  Subsequent calls to the JIT are bypassed when this value is
non-NULL.  This leads to a situation where the main program and its
func[0] counterpart are both in the bpf kallsyms tree
has an extable.  Extables are only created during JIT.  Now there are
two nearly identical program ksym entries in the tree
an extable.  Depending upon how the entries are placed
that a fault will call search_extable on the aux with the NULL entry.
Since jit_subprogs already copies state from func[0] to the main
program
column2: include the extable pointer in this state duplication.

column1: Additionally
column2: ensure that the copy of the main program in func[0] is not

column1: added to the bpf_prog_kallsyms table. Instead
added later in bpf_prog_load().  This ensures there is only a single
copy of the main program in the kallsyms table
the tag observed by tooling like bpftool.
